decision: Replaced flat header+pill-nav layout with VSCode spatial grammar: activity-bar (48px, col 1) | sidebar/explorer (220px, col 2) | editor-area (flex col: title-bar + tab-bar + breadcrumb + content, col 3) + status-bar (22px, row 2, full width). Grid: `var(--vsc-activity-w) var(--sidebar-w) 1fr / 1fr var(--vsc-status-h)`. Nav nodes moved from inline pill tabs to vertical list items in sidebar with left-border active indicator. Status bar background uses `rgba(0,100,160,0.92)` (VSCode blue adapted to HUD opacity model). All existing JS IDs preserved (`#module-content`, `#sidebar-nav`, `.nav-node[data-module]`, all footer IDs). MutationObserver inline script syncs tab-bar and breadcrumb with active nav-node class changes.
pattern: VSCode layout shell: grid(activity | sidebar | editor / content | statusbar). Editor area = flex-col with title-bar, tab-bar, breadcrumb, scrollable content. Activity bar = icon-only with left-border active state. Sidebar = vertical nav list with grouped sections + dividers. Status bar = 22px full-width strip.
